messages:
Carmen: Drafting a compact field one-pager called 'LaunchPad Secure'  one-pager + webinar + benchmark blurbs. Focus: secure inference, SLA clarity, and deploy-mode decisioning. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/briefs/launchpad-secure (internal).

Noah: Nice. Quick Q  whos the primary buyer? Platform leads + CISOs? We should lead with a single measurable stat.

Tessa: Suggest hero line: "Run compliant, low-latency inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Hero stat: "~39% lower inference unit cost (typical)". Conservative and defensible.

Ibrahim: Bench notes: Dedicated + KV cache + 4-bit quantization + smart batching. Typical wins: 352% cost, 250% 95th-pct latency depending on model. I'll attach PNGs to the brief.

Carmen: For SLAs I propose: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Private (VPC/on-prem): contractual SLA options; Hosted: regional redundancy + automated fallback." Keep short.

Noah: Field asks for clear inbound routing tags so AEs can filter by deployment interest and urgency. Proposed YAML for ops intake: 
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","LaunchPadSecure","secure-inference","vpc","onprem","dedicated","SLA","eval-kit","nda-needed"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel_label: evaluation-request
  intake_note: "attach workload sample, latency targets, and compliance/regulatory notes"
```

Tessa: Add quick-filter tags: 'bring-your-model' and 'infosec-review' per field request. Also include 'partner-pilot' if they want co-dev.

Ibrahim: Webinar headline (short): "LaunchPad Secure: predictable inference for regulated apps". Blurb: "40-minute deep dive: secure serving patterns, benchmark stories, and a guided walkthrough of our evaluation kit. Bring your workload for a tailored ops report. Live Q&A with product + field." Agenda: 1) architecture & SLA options 2) benchmark deep-dive 3) evaluation kit demo + next steps.

Carmen: Social post (short): "New brief: LaunchPad Secure  how teams cut inference cost, hit SLAs, and deploy privately. Register for the webinar & request an evaluation kit: [link + UTM]" Keep it punchy.

Noah: Field appendix request: 1-line sales play (discovery checklist: workload profile, throughput/latency targets, compliance), pricing appendix, demo next steps.

ops-bot: Webinar slot request submitted for 2026-07-22 10:00 PT  request ID 7420.

Carmen: Thanks all. If no objections I'll publish the internal brief tomorrow AM and hand the routing YAML to ops. Owners: copy (Tessa), benchmarks & PNGs (Ibrahim), routing handoff (Noah), webinar comms (Carmen). :white_check_mark:
